subject: Refining automated codebase pruning with AST analysis
intent: I want to share my approach for an AST-based dependency analyzer to manage autonomous codebase pruning and ask for their perspective on balancing static analysis complexity versus developer autonomy in small projects.
target_described: Haki Benita, a prolific Python developer and blogger known for his deep-dive posts on Python internals and practical engineering solutions. He maintains various utility libraries (e.g., django-zen-queries) and his personal site lists a direct contact email, making him an ideal source for insights on pragmatic architectural decisions.
